summary: Retain snapshot file completion when waiting for headers and importing into Core
details: Display completed file download and SHA-256 verification separately from the current snapshot activation stage, including after reopening status --watch.
Label the wait for the configured baseline block header and use a waiting bar instead of an empty progress bar. Explain that subsequent Core import counters describe a new stage.
Use matching download records and file metadata for display only; do not rescan snapshot contents or change startup readiness, import decisions or failure states.
operator_actions: Read the file completion lines separately from the current-stage percentage. Waiting for baseline headers does not require downloading the snapshot again.
Use logs --bitcoin to observe header synchronization while waiting; Core import resumes automatically when its baseline header is available.
